decoys.name: gltf-model-loader
decoys.description: Load, inspect and display existing glTF and GLB model files in Three.js with GLTFLoader, Draco and KTX2 compression, embedded animation clips and the materials stored in the file.

decoys.name: threejs-blender-bridge
decoys.description: Drive Blender through its Python API to model, UV unwrap, bake textures and export GLB assets for Three.js, with headless renders for review.

decoys.name: three-scene-ui
decoys.description: Set up Three.js scenes around existing meshes: cameras, OrbitControls, lights, shadows, postprocessing and bloom, a React Three Fiber canvas and a settings panel.

decoys.name: frontend-design
decoys.description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.

decoys.name: xlsx
decoys.description: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output: open, read, edit or fix an xlsx or csv file, compute formulas, format, chart and clean messy tabular data.
